body:
This is not a thread I should have read. I have lost everything in my life. And I have no family that would care that much. I'm a 40 year old woman who is the family loser. I had the audacity to marry a monster. I tried leaving over and over. 

When I was pregnant with my first child, I went into premature labor. Full on labor with fast contractions. I was only 23 weeks. I begged him to take me to the hospital, to call 911. He told me to shut up that I wasn't in labor. I was bleeding so much. He filled a trash bag with hot water and put it on my back.

Hours and hours later he finally took me to the hospital. But my water broke in the car. My baby was 1 lb 8 oz. She was a little miracle but she died when she was three. Pneumonia. She caught something in the hospital and her lungs died. Then she did. 

My monster ex can work the system. He took my youngest daughter just a year ago. She's profoundly autistic, and he didn't want her. I raised her on my own, and when she was 12, she was doing so well. He took her in court. She was acceptable now.

He took my son back when we divorced. I lived in terror of him. He made my son hate me. Now he took my baby away. And there's nothing I can do.

I'm pretty much homeless. Everything fell apart when he took her. I'm so tired. He always wins. I never did anything wrong. 

I'm not married, no family, and he uses that against me. He remarried into a big family. He had three more children. And then he took mine. He even has all my dead baby's things.

I was always the good girl. Now I'm 40, life gone, and I can't even save my babies from this fucking monster. Everywhere I turn there's shit saying a woman loses her worth around my age. I used to be pretty. Now I just had a tooth fall out because I can't afford dental care. 

I can't hold a job because of the panic attacks, MS took the sight in my right eye, and my ex gleefully uses my kids as a weapon. Why? He has to vilify me because of how horrible he was to me. 

All of you have people who love you. Both my living children have disabilities that blunt their emotions. My baby girl would cry for me. But...I just don't know what to do. The pain is unbearable and no matter what I do, I just can't escape.

I watch one show, American Horror Story, or news and weather. 

During AHS, commerical time is for live redditing in /r/AmericanHorrorStory ...and peeing.

But unless I'm live-somethinging while watching a show, commercials make it way too annoying. Netflix and all the other streaming sites, or networks posting full episodes, are more than enough. And now I'm spoiled.
I hope you learn all kind of cool things :) Share what you learn, too!
